design.algorithm: DSAC actor + distributional twin quantile critic + CVaR policy objective + CQL regularization
design.scope: Alpha3 entry stack frozen. DSAC exit owner chooses hold-with-guard, market close, maker close, partial close, or TWAP-style reduce-only actions.
design.feature_design: Feature mode is fixed to state16_topbase20 from Alpha3 exit-owner feature analysis 20260515.
design.limitations: No L2/orderbook/queue inputs or labels by request. Maker fills use existing OHLC immediate-limit proxy; partial/TWAP rewards are synthetic approximations and event-gated to avoid churn.

reward_design.market_close_100: baseline immediate limit fallback target minus direct taker/urgency cost.
reward_design.maker_close_100: exit0/2/4 OHLC immediate-limit proxy targets minus maker offset risk cost.
reward_design.partial_close: Masked unless profitable and mature; 45% realized close value plus 55% hold continuation with larger MAE/action penalty.
reward_design.twap_maker2: Masked unless strong profit plus giveback; 25% maker2 close value plus 75% hold continuation with time/action penalty.
reward_design.hold_with_guard: Hold continuation with mild exit-advantage/giveback/age penalty to prevent premature churn.

feature_encoder.source: Alpha3 exit-owner feature analysis 20260515: keep state16 raw; optionally add top_base20 raw and/or target-aware base PLS-8.
